string-array.name: eco_facts
string-array.item: The world generated a record 62 million tonnes of e-waste in 2022, and only about 22% of it was formally collected and recycled.
A tonne of discarded mobile phones contains more gold than a tonne of gold ore.
E-waste can contain lead, mercury and cadmium, which leach into soil and groundwater when dumped.
India is one of the three largest generators of e-waste in the world, after China and the United States.
Reusing a laptop for a few more years saves far more energy than recycling it, because most of its footprint comes from manufacturing.
